name: Methamnetamine
summary: A selective serotonin releaser, which also shows some light psychedelic activity. Almost always taken with a stimulant, to cause euphoric effects.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: Methamnetamine acts as a releasing agent of serotonin, norepinephrine, and dopamine, with EC50 values of 13 nM, 34 nM, and 10 nM, respectively. It is also a lower-potency partial agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor.

uses.text: It has been sold online as a designer drug between 2015 and 2016.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. As a releaser of serotonin, dopamine and noradrenaline, it can be expected to cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, overheating and anxiety, with a risk of serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。作為血清素、多巴胺與正腎上腺素的釋放劑，可預期它會引起心跳過快、血壓上升、體溫過高與焦慮，並有血清素症候群的風險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。作为血清素、多巴胺与正肾上腺素的释放剂，可预期它会引起心跳过快、血压上升、体温过高与焦虑，并有血清素症候群的风险。

fact.en: Methamnetamine is methamphetamine with its benzene ring swapped for naphthalene, a two-ring system best known as the main ingredient of old-fashioned mothballs.
fact.zh: Methamnetamine 是把甲基安非他命的苯環換成萘，萘是一種雙環結構，最為人知的是作為傳統樟腦丸的主要成分。
fact.zhHans: Methamnetamine 是把甲基安非他命的苯环换成萘，萘是一种双环结构，最为人知的是作为传统樟脑丸的主要成分。
